subject: Dedicated capacity proposal: H100 / A100 / L40S mix for Skystack
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@skystack.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — throughput for embeddings + chat

Hi Aisha,

We ran a quick spike with your hosted API and are now evaluating a Dedicated commit. Two main asks:
- Cost/perf tradeoff for H100 vs A100 vs L40S by workload (chat LLM vs batched embeddings).
- A sample committed shape (how many GPUs of each type) and an estimated monthly cost with throughput guarantees (tokens/sec or embeddings/sec).

Current profile: ~200k embedding requests/day in bursts, 50k chat messages/day (avg 120 tokens). Latency target: 95p < 200ms for chat generation.

Can you share a proposal and an example SLA? Also curious about discount bands for 12 vs 24 month commits and whether we can mix GPUs in one pool.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP Product, Skystack Analytics

(Procurement cc'd)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@skystack.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — throughput for embeddings + chat

Jordan — thanks for the clear profile. Looping in Karthik (pricing) and Marissa (enterprise sales) to draft an initial shape.

Quick answers up front: yes, you can mix GPU types in a single Dedicated deployment; routing policies let us send latency-sensitive traffic to H100-backed nodes and batch embeddings to L40S pools to save cost. I'll follow up with a concrete matrix and a 12 v 24 month pricing delta.

Next steps: if you can share a short spike log (peak qps, payload size) we can sharpen throughput numbers — but I included rough estimates below based on our running assumptions.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — throughput for embeddings + chat

Aisha / Marissa — did a quick back-of-envelope and attached a draft pricing matrix. Key assumptions:
- Chat workload mapped to a 70/30 split between H100 and A100 depending on sequence length. H100 gives ~1.6-1.9x throughput on long-context chat workloads vs A100 at our token-level benchmarks; perf/$ depends heavily on memory config.
- Embeddings (batched RPCs) are cheaper on L40S for bulk throughput; L40S is 40-60% lower $/embedding at typical batch sizes because of lower instance-hour pricing and similar kernels for dense embeddings.

Suggested committed shapes (monthly reserved GPUs, 12mo):
- Conservative (start): 2x H100-80GB, 4x A100-80GB, 8x L40S-48GB — covers 95p chat < 220ms and embeddings bursts up to 300k/day with autoscale headroom.
- Aggressive (target performance): 4x H100-80GB, 6x A100-80GB, 12x L40S-48GB — keeps 95p chat < 160ms and much better steady throughput.

Estimated committed pricing (USD/month, list before discount):
- Conservative: $176k/mo
- Aggressive: $384k/mo

Discount bands to propose: 12mo = 10% off list; 24mo = 18% off list; higher tiers (>$4M ARR commit) negotiable. We can also offer a blended per-token effective rate as a guarantee for the deal.

Notes on guarantees: throughput SLOs need tie-ins to model variant (we recommend pinning a model family for SLOs). Fallback policies: when H100 capacity is saturated, we can route to A100 with graceful latency degradation and a contractual CPU-backed emergency fallback. SLA credits aligned to percent uptime of Dedicated control plane + model-serving latency windows.

I attached: skystack-pricing-matrix-q2.pdf (draft numbers), proposed-commit-sla-2027.docx (SLA template).

-Karthik
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@skystack.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — throughput for embeddings + chat

Aisha / team — quick commercial guidance:
- Packaging: propose a "Tiered Commitment" product: baseline reserved pool (blended GPUs) + burstable reserved capacity (monthly overflow credits). This lets customers avoid big up-front commits while giving predictability.
- Discount structure: for first year, we can extend an 'onboarding credit' of 8% on the first 3 months for proof-of-performance, in addition to the 12mo 10% band Karthik mentioned — combineable up to ~16% in the first quarter as a forgiveness/POC incentive.
- Payment terms: Net 30 standard; for 24mo we push Net 45 + annual true-up.

Operational asks to include in SLA: maintenance windows, planned capacity notice (72h), and a model-variant pin so that performance guarantees are meaningful. Also include an explicit 'routing priority' table so we can commit 95p latency for chat routed to H100.

Jordan — if you like, we can propose a 3-month ramp plan in the contract (start smaller, autoscale cushion, review at 90 days). That reduces your risk and lets us tune quantization/kv-cache settings for better perf/$ mix.

-Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — committed shape + draft pricing (proposal attached)

Jordan — attaching the proposal and SLA draft for your review. TL;DR of the recommended path:
- Offer: 12-month Tiered Commitment (start conservative): 2x H100-80GB + 4x A100-80GB + 8x L40S-48GB reserved.
- Commercials: list $176k/mo -> 12mo discount 10% -> effective $158.4k/mo. We can add a 3-month onboarding credit (8%) applied as one-time credit if you sign by May 15.
- Guarantees: 95p chat latency < 220ms when routed to H100, embeddings throughput SLA 250k/day sustained with autoscale headroom. SLA language and routing priority table are in the attached docx.
- Flex: pool can mix GPUs and we provide routing by policy (latency vs cost). If you require stricter 95p < 200ms we recommend moving to the aggressive shape (add 2x H100, +$208k/mo after discounts).

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, I'll send a DocuSign for the MSA + SOW and a redline window for procurement.
2) We schedule a 30-min technical runbook with our infra team (Rachel) to confirm network/VPC setup and peering.
